fields.name: IDataProviderServiceFactory provider execution family
fields.contract: IDataProviderServiceFactory is the platform-specific seam a database provider package implements on behalf of the provider-neutral library: GetIsErrorTransient(exception) reports whether a given exception represents a transient failure condition; NewConnection(connectionString) produces a DbConnection for that connection string; NewCommand(storedProcedureName, connection) produces a DbCommand constructed to target the named stored procedure (storedProcedureName) on that connection, ready for the caller to populate with parameters and execute; SetParameters(cmd, parmeterNames, parameters, parameterValues) applies the named set of parameters identified by parmeterNames, drawn from the supplied parameters collection and parameterValues dictionary, to cmd. Each provider package supplies its own connection, command, parameter-population and transient-classification logic; this interface fixes the four obligations each provider must meet, not the mechanism by which it meets any of them.
